en: Hi everyone, I'm Esther.
zh: 大家好，我是Esther。
ja: みなさん、こんにちは。エスターです。
local: Hi everyone, I'm Esther.
ja_pron: Minasan, konnichiwa. Esutā desu.
native: Hi everyone, I'm Esther.

en: In this video, I will introduce the future simple tense using will and be going to.
zh: 在這個影片中，我將介紹使用 will 和 be going to 的未來簡單式。
ja: この動画では、will と be going to を使った未来形を紹介します。
local: In this video, I will introduce the future simple tense using will and be going to.
ja_pron: Kono dōga de wa, will to be going to o tsukatta miraikei o shōkai shimasu.
native: In this video, I will introduce the future simple tense using will and be going to.

en: This is a very important tense that will help you express future actions and plans.
zh: 這是一個非常重要的時態，能幫助你表達未來的行動和計畫。
ja: これは未来の行動や計画を表すのにとても重要な時制です。
local: This is a very important tense that will help you express future actions and plans.
ja_pron: Kore wa mirai no kōdō ya keikaku o arawasu no ni totemo jūyō na jisei desu.
native: This is a very important tense that will help you express future actions and plans.

en: There's a lot to learn, so let's get started.
zh: 有很多東西要學，讓我們開始吧。
ja: 学ぶことがたくさんあります。さあ、始めましょう。
local: There's a lot to learn, so let's get started.
ja_pron: Manabu koto ga takusan arimasu. Saa, hajimemashou.
native: There's a lot to learn, so let's get started.

en: The future simple tense can be used to express a future action.
zh: 未來簡單式可以用來表達未來的行動。
ja: 未来形は未来の行動を表すために使われます。
local: The future simple tense can be used to express a future action.
ja_pron: Miraikei wa mirai no kōdō o arawasu tame ni tsukawaremasu.
native: The future simple tense can be used to express a future action.

en: Let's take a look at some examples.
zh: 讓我們來看一些例子。
ja: いくつか例を見てみましょう。
local: Let's take a look at some examples.
ja_pron: Ikutsuka rei o mitemimashou.
native: Let's take a look at some examples.

en: I'm cold.
zh: 我很冷。
ja: 寒いです。
local: I'm cold.
ja_pron: Samui desu.
native: I'm cold.

en: Well, that's right now.
zh: 嗯，那是現在的狀況。
ja: それは今のことです。
local: Well, that's right now.
ja_pron: Sore wa ima no koto desu.
native: Well, that's right now.

en: I will close the window.
zh: 我會關窗戶。
ja: 窓を閉めます。
local: I will close the window.
ja_pron: Mado o shimemasu.
native: I will close the window.

en: We start with the subject, will and then the base verb.
zh: 我們先用主詞，接著是 will，然後是動詞原形。
ja: 主語、will、そして動詞の原形の順に使います。
local: We start with the subject, will and then the base verb.
ja_pron: Shugo, will, soshite dōshi no genkei no jun ni tsukaimasu.
native: We start with the subject, will and then the base verb.

en: I will close the window.
zh: 我會關窗戶。
ja: 窓を閉めます。
local: I will close the window.
ja_pron: Mado o shimemasu.
native: I will close the window.

en: In this example, I'm making a sudden decision because how I feel right now.
zh: 在這個例子中，我是因為現在的感覺而突然做出決定。
ja: この例では、今の気持ちで突然決めています。
local: In this example, I'm making a sudden decision because how I feel right now.
ja_pron: Kono rei de wa, ima no kimochi de totsuzen kimete imasu.
native: In this example, I'm making a sudden decision because how I feel right now.

en: I will close the window because I'm cold right now.
zh: 我會關窗戶，因為我現在很冷。
ja: 寒いので窓を閉めます。
local: I will close the window because I'm cold right now.
ja_pron: Samui node mado o shimemasu.
native: I will close the window because I'm cold right now.

en: I will be at the library tomorrow.
zh: 我明天會在圖書館。
ja: 私は明日図書館にいます。
local: I will be at the library tomorrow.
ja_pron: Watashi wa ashita toshokan ni imasu.
native: I will be at the library tomorrow.

en: Again, you start with the subject and then will.
zh: 同樣地，先用主詞，接著是 will。
ja: もう一度、主語の後に will を使います。
local: Again, you start with the subject and then will.
ja_pron: Mōichido, shugo no ato ni will o tsukaimasu.
native: Again, you start with the subject and then will.

en: After that, you have the base verb.
zh: 接著是動詞原形。
ja: その後に動詞の原形を使います。
local: After that, you have the base verb.
ja_pron: Sono ato ni dōshi no genkei o tsukaimasu.
native: After that, you have the base verb.

en: You can use the be verb to talk about a confirmed plan.
zh: 你可以用 be 動詞來談論已確定的計畫。
ja: 確定した計画について話すときは be 動詞を使えます。
local: You can use the be verb to talk about a confirmed plan.
ja_pron: Kakutei shita keikaku ni tsuite hanasu toki wa be dōshi o tsukaemasu.
native: You can use the be verb to talk about a confirmed plan.

en: I will be at the library tomorrow.
zh: 我明天會在圖書館。
ja: 私は明日図書館にいます。
local: I will be at the library tomorrow.
ja_pron: Watashi wa ashita toshokan ni imasu.
native: I will be at the library tomorrow.

en: The economy will get better next year.
zh: 經濟明年會變好。
ja: 経済は来年良くなるでしょう。
local: The economy will get better next year.
ja_pron: Keizai wa rainen yoku naru deshō.
native: The economy will get better next year.

en: In this case, the subject is the economy.
zh: 在這個例子中，主詞是經濟。
ja: この場合、主語は経済です。
local: In this case, the subject is the economy.
ja_pron: Kono baai, shugo wa keizai desu.
native: In this case, the subject is the economy.

en: Again, we follow with will and the base verb get.
zh: 同樣地，我們接著用 will 和動詞原形 get。
ja: もう一度、will と動詞の原形 get を使います。
local: Again, we follow with will and the base verb get.
ja_pron: Mōichido, will to dōshi no genkei get o tsukaimasu.
native: Again, we follow with will and the base verb get.

en: The economy will get better next year.
zh: 經濟明年會變好。
ja: 経済は来年良くなるでしょう。
local: The economy will get better next year.
ja_pron: Keizai wa rainen yoku naru deshō.
native: The economy will get better next year.

en: I'm making a prediction here about something that will happen in the future.
zh: 我在這裡對未來會發生的事情做出預測。
ja: ここでは未来に起こることを予測しています。
local: I'm making a prediction here about something that will happen in the future.
ja_pron: Koko de wa mirai ni okoru koto o yosoku shite imasu.
native: I'm making a prediction here about something that will happen in the future.

en: And finally, I will help you with your homework.
zh: 最後，我會幫你做功課。
ja: 最後に、宿題を手伝います。
local: And finally, I will help you with your homework.
ja_pron: Saigo ni, shukudai o tetsudaimasu.
native: And finally, I will help you with your homework.

en: I'm making a future plan to help you.
zh: 我正在做一個幫助你的未來計畫。
ja: あなたを助ける未来の計画を立てています。
local: I'm making a future plan to help you.
ja_pron: Anata o tasukeru mirai no keikaku o tatete imasu.
native: I'm making a future plan to help you.

en: I will help you with your homework.
zh: 我會幫你做功課。
ja: 宿題を手伝います。
local: I will help you with your homework.
ja_pron: Shukudai o tetsudaimasu.
native: I will help you with your homework.

en: It doesn't say when, but I am talking about the future.
zh: 雖然沒說什麼時候，但我是在談論未來。
ja: いつかは言っていませんが、未来のことを話しています。
local: It doesn't say when, but I am talking about the future.
ja_pron: Itsu ka wa itte imasen ga, mirai no koto o hanashite imasu.
native: It doesn't say when, but I am talking about the future.

en: Let's move on.
zh: 讓我們繼續。
ja: 続けましょう。
local: Let's move on.
ja_pron: Tsuzukemashou.
native: Let's move on.

en: You can also use be going to to express a future action.
zh: 你也可以用 be going to 來表達未來的行動。
ja: 未来の行動を表すのに be going to も使えます。
local: You can also use be going to to express a future action.
ja_pron: Mirai no kōdō o arawasu no ni be going to mo tsukaemasu.
native: You can also use be going to to express a future action.

en: It's almost the same as will.
zh: 它和 will 幾乎一樣。
ja: ほとんど will と同じです。
local: It's almost the same as will.
ja_pron: Hotondo will to onaji desu.
native: It's almost the same as will.

en: Here are some examples.
zh: 這裡有一些例子。
ja: いくつか例を見てみましょう。
local: Here are some examples.
ja_pron: Ikutsuka rei o mitemimashou.
native: Here are some examples.

en: There's no milk.
zh: 沒有牛奶。
ja: 牛乳がありません。
local: There's no milk.
ja_pron: Gyūnyū ga arimasen.
native: There's no milk.

en: I'm going to buy some.
zh: 我要去買一些。
ja: 買いに行きます。
local: I'm going to buy some.
ja_pron: Kai ni ikimasu.
native: I'm going to buy some.

en: So what you see here is the subject and then the be verb am.
zh: 所以你看到的是主詞，接著是 be 動詞 am。
ja: ここでは主語の後に be 動詞の am を使います。
local: So what you see here is the subject and then the be verb am.
ja_pron: Koko de wa shugo no ato ni be dōshi no am o tsukaimasu.
native: So what you see here is the subject and then the be verb am.

en: I am.
zh: 我是。
ja: 私は。
local: I am.
ja_pron: Watashi wa.
native: I am.

en: And then here, we use a contraction.
zh: 然後這裡，我們用縮寫。
ja: そしてここでは短縮形を使います。
local: And then here, we use a contraction.
ja_pron: Soshite koko de wa tanshuku-kei o tsukaimasu.
native: And then here, we use a contraction.

en: I'm going to buy some.
zh: 我要去買一些。
ja: 買いに行きます。
local: I'm going to buy some.
ja_pron: Kai ni ikimasu.
native: I'm going to buy some.

en: I made a decision to buy some because there's no milk.
zh: 因為沒有牛奶，我決定去買一些。
ja: 牛乳がないので買うことに決めました。
local: I made a decision to buy some because there's no milk.
ja_pron: Gyūnyū ga nai node kau koto ni kimemashita.
native: I made a decision to buy some because there's no milk.

en: The next sentence says it looks like it's going to snow tomorrow.
zh: 下一句說看起來明天會下雪。
ja: 次の文は、明日雪が降りそうだと言っています。
local: The next sentence says it looks like it's going to snow tomorrow.
ja_pron: Tsugi no bun wa, ashita yuki ga furisō da to itte imasu.
native: The next sentence says it looks like it's going to snow tomorrow.

en: Here the subject is it and so I use the be verb is.
zh: 這裡主詞是 it，所以我用 be 動詞 is。
ja: ここでは主語が it なので be 動詞の is を使います。
local: Here the subject is it and so I use the be verb is.
ja_pron: Koko de wa shugo ga it nano de be dōshi no is o tsukaimasu.
native: Here the subject is it and so I use the be verb is.

en: It is.
zh: 它是。
ja: それは。
local: It is.
ja_pron: Sore wa.
native: It is.

en: It's is the contraction.
zh: It's 是縮寫。
ja: It's は短縮形です。
local: It's is the contraction.
ja_pron: It's wa tanshuku-kei desu.
native: It's is the contraction.

en: It's going to and then we use the base verb snow.
zh: It's going to，然後接動詞原形 snow。
ja: It's going to の後に動詞の原形 snow を使います。
local: It's going to and then we use the base verb snow.
ja_pron: It's going to no ato ni dōshi no genkei snow o tsukaimasu.
native: It's going to and then we use the base verb snow.

en: The word tomorrow shows that this is a future action.
zh: tomorrow 這個字表示這是未來的行動。
ja: tomorrow という言葉が未来の行動であることを示しています。
local: The word tomorrow shows that this is a future action.
ja_pron: Tomorrow to iu kotoba ga mirai no kōdō de aru koto o shimeshite imasu.
native: The word tomorrow shows that this is a future action.

en: He's going to take a trip in the summer because the subject is he.
zh: 他夏天要去旅行，因為主詞是 he。
ja: 主語が he なので、彼は夏に旅行に行きます。
local: He's going to take a trip in the summer because the subject is he.
ja_pron: Shugo ga he nano de, kare wa natsu ni ryokō ni ikimasu.
native: He's going to take a trip in the summer because the subject is he.

en: We use the be verb is and we can use the contraction.
zh: 我們用 be 動詞 is，也可以用縮寫。
ja: be 動詞の is を使い、短縮形も使えます。
local: We use the be verb is and we can use the contraction.
ja_pron: Be dōshi no is o tsukai, tanshuku-kei mo tsukaemasu.
native: We use the be verb is and we can use the contraction.

en: He's he is or he's going to and then the base verb take.
zh: He's 是 he is 或 he's going to，然後接動詞原形 take。
ja: He's は he is または he's going to の短縮形で、その後に動詞の原形 take を使います。
local: He's he is or he's going to and then the base verb take.
ja_pron: He's wa he is matawa he's going to no tanshuku-kei de, sono ato ni dōshi no genkei take o tsukaimasu.
native: He's he is or he's going to and then the base verb take.

en: Take a trip in the summer again and action happening in the future.
zh: 再次強調夏天去旅行，是未來發生的行動。
ja: 夏に旅行に行くという未来の行動です。
local: Take a trip in the summer again and action happening in the future.
ja_pron: Natsu ni ryokō ni iku to iu mirai no kōdō desu.
native: Take a trip in the summer again and action happening in the future.

en: Let's move on.
zh: 讓我們繼續。
ja: 続けましょう。
local: Let's move on.
ja_pron: Tsuzukemashou.
native: Let's move on.

en: Now let's take a look at the negative form of the future simple tense.
zh: 現在讓我們來看看未來簡單式的否定形。
ja: では、未来形の否定形を見てみましょう。
local: Now let's take a look at the negative form of the future simple tense.
ja_pron: Dewa, miraikei no hiteikei o mitemimashou.
native: Now let's take a look at the negative form of the future simple tense.

en: The first example says Stan will not like his English score.
zh: 第一個例子說 Stan 不會喜歡他的英文成績。
ja: 最初の例は、スタンは英語の点数を気に入らないと言っています。
local: The first example says Stan will not like his English score.
ja_pron: Saisho no rei wa, Sutan wa eigo no tensū o kiniiranai to itte imasu.
native: The first example says Stan will not like his English score.

en: No matter what the subject is, we follow with will not and then the base form of the verb.
zh: 不管主詞是什麼，我們接著用 will not，然後是動詞原形。
ja: 主語が何であっても、will not の後に動詞の原形を使います。
local: No matter what the subject is, we follow with will not and then the base form of the verb.
ja_pron: Shugo ga nan de atte mo, will not no ato ni dōshi no genkei o tsukaimasu.
native: No matter what the subject is, we follow with will not and then the base form of the verb.

en: Stan will not like his English score.
zh: Stan 不會喜歡他的英文成績。
ja: スタンは英語の点数を気に入らないでしょう。
local: Stan will not like his English score.
ja_pron: Sutan wa eigo no tensū o kiniiranai deshō.
native: Stan will not like his English score.

en: We won't give you money anymore.
zh: 我們不會再給你錢了。
ja: もうお金をあげません。
local: We won't give you money anymore.
ja_pron: Mō okane o agemasen.
native: We won't give you money anymore.

en: In this case, the subject is we and we follow with the contraction won't.
zh: 在這個例子中，主詞是 we，我們用縮寫 won't。
ja: この場合、主語は we で、短縮形の won't を使います。
local: In this case, the subject is we and we follow with the contraction won't.
ja_pron: Kono baai, shugo wa we de, tanshuku-kei no won't o tsukaimasu.
native: In this case, the subject is we and we follow with the contraction won't.

en: It sounds really different and it's different from other contractions.
zh: 它聽起來很不一樣，也和其他縮寫不同。
ja: 音がとても違っていて、他の短縮形とは異なります。
local: It sounds really different and it's different from other contractions.
ja_pron: Oto ga totemo chigatte ite, hoka no tanshuku-kei to wa kotonarimasu.
native: It sounds really different and it's different from other contractions.

en: But won't is the contraction for will not.
zh: 但是 won't 是 will not 的縮寫。
ja: しかし、won't は will not の短縮形です。
local: But won't is the contraction for will not.
ja_pron: Shikashi, won't wa will not no tanshuku-kei desu.
native: But won't is the contraction for will not.

en: So you can say we will not or we won't.
zh: 所以你可以說 we will not 或 we won't。
ja: だから、we will not か we won't と言えます。
local: So you can say we will not or we won't.
ja_pron: Dakara, we will not ka we won't to iemasu.
native: So you can say we will not or we won't.

en: They're the same.
zh: 它們是相同的意思。
ja: 同じ意味です。
local: They're the same.
ja_pron: Onaji imi desu.
native: They're the same.

en: We won't give you money anymore.
zh: 我們不會再給你錢了。
ja: もうお金をあげません。
local: We won't give you money anymore.
ja_pron: Mō okane o agemasen.
native: We won't give you money anymore.

en: Again, you notice the base verb give after not.
zh: 再一次，你會注意到 not 後面接動詞原形 give。
ja: もう一度、not の後に動詞の原形 give が続くことに気づきます。
local: Again, you notice the base verb give after not.
ja_pron: Mōichido, not no ato ni dōshi no genkei give ga tsuzuku koto ni kidzukimasu.
native: Again, you notice the base verb give after not.

en: He is not going to fly until next week.
zh: 他直到下週才會飛。
ja: 彼は来週まで飛びません。
local: He is not going to fly until next week.
ja_pron: Kare wa raishū made tobimasen.
native: He is not going to fly until next week.

en: This sentence uses be going to.
zh: 這句話使用 be going to。
ja: この文は be going to を使っています。
local: This sentence uses be going to.
ja_pron: Kono bun wa be going to o tsukatte imasu.
native: This sentence uses be going to.

en: The subject is he and therefore the beaver we use is is.
zh: 主詞是 he，所以用 be 動詞 is。
ja: 主語は he なので、be 動詞は is を使います。
local: The subject is he and therefore the beaver we use is is.
ja_pron: Shugo wa he nano de, be dōshi wa is o tsukaimasu.
native: The subject is he and therefore the beaver we use is is.

en: However, we put a not after the beaver.
zh: 不過，我們在 be 動詞後面加 not。
ja: しかし、be 動詞の後に not を置きます。
local: However, we put a not after the beaver.
ja_pron: Shikashi, be dōshi no ato ni not o okimasu.
native: However, we put a not after the beaver.

en: He is not going to and then the base verb.
zh: 他不會去，然後接動詞原形。
ja: He is not going to の後に動詞の原形を使います。
local: He is not going to and then the base verb.
ja_pron: He is not going to no ato ni dōshi no genkei o tsukaimasu.
native: He is not going to and then the base verb.

en: He is not going to fly until next week.
zh: 他直到下週才會飛。
ja: 彼は来週まで飛びません。
local: He is not going to fly until next week.
ja_pron: Kare wa raishū made tobimasen.
native: He is not going to fly until next week.

en: The last sentence says you are not going to go to the party tonight.
zh: 最後一句說你今晚不會去派對。
ja: 最後の文は、あなたは今夜パーティーに行かないと言っています。
local: The last sentence says you are not going to go to the party tonight.
ja_pron: Saigo no bun wa, anata wa kon'ya pātī ni ikanai to itte imasu.
native: The last sentence says you are not going to go to the party tonight.

en: The subject is you and so we use the beaver are.
zh: 主詞是 you，所以用 be 動詞 are。
ja: 主語は you なので、be 動詞は are を使います。
local: The subject is you and so we use the beaver are.
ja_pron: Shugo wa you nano de, be dōshi wa are o tsukaimasu.
native: The subject is you and so we use the beaver are.

en: You are not going to go that's the base verb to the party tonight.
zh: 你不會去，那是動詞原形，今晚去派對。
ja: You are not going to go は動詞の原形で、今夜パーティーに行かないという意味です。
local: You are not going to go that's the base verb to the party tonight.
ja_pron: You are not going to go wa dōshi no genkei de, kon'ya pātī ni ikanai to iu imi desu.
native: You are not going to go that's the base verb to the party tonight.

en: Let's move on.
zh: 讓我們繼續。
ja: 続けましょう。
local: Let's move on.
ja_pron: Tsuzukemashou.
native: Let's move on.

en: Now let's take a look at how to form basic questions in the future simple tense.
zh: 現在讓我們來看看如何形成未來簡單式的基本疑問句。
ja: では、未来形の基本的な疑問文の作り方を見てみましょう。
local: Now let's take a look at how to form basic questions in the future simple tense.
ja_pron: Dewa, miraikei no kihonteki na gimonbun no tsukurikata o mitemimashou.
native: Now let's take a look at how to form basic questions in the future simple tense.

en: The first sentence says he will play with us.
zh: 第一句說他會和我們一起玩。
ja: 最初の文は、彼は私たちと遊ぶと言っています。
local: The first sentence says he will play with us.
ja_pron: Saisho no bun wa, kare wa watashitachi to asobu to itte imasu.
native: The first sentence says he will play with us.

en: To turn this into a question, all we have to do is change the order of the first two words.
zh: 要把它變成疑問句，只要把前兩個字的順序調換。
ja: これを疑問文にするには、最初の二語の順序を入れ替えるだけです。
local: To turn this into a question, all we have to do is change the order of the first two words.
ja_pron: Kore o gimonbun ni suru ni wa, saisho no nigo no junjo o irekaeru dake desu.
native: To turn this into a question, all we have to do is change the order of the first two words.

en: So he will becomes will he.
zh: 所以 he will 變成 will he。
ja: だから he will は will he になります。
local: So he will becomes will he.
ja_pron: Dakara he will wa will he ni narimasu.
native: So he will becomes will he.

en: Will he play with us?
zh: 他會和我們一起玩嗎？
ja: 彼は私たちと遊びますか？
local: Will he play with us?
ja_pron: Kare wa watashitachi to asobimasu ka?
native: Will he play with us?

en: The next sentence says he is going to play with us.
zh: 下一句說他打算和我們一起玩。
ja: 次の文は、彼は私たちと遊ぶつもりだと言っています。
local: The next sentence says he is going to play with us.
ja_pron: Tsugi no bun wa, kare wa watashitachi to asobu tsumori da to itte imasu.
native: The next sentence says he is going to play with us.

en: This one uses be going to.
zh: 這句使用 be going to。
ja: これは be going to を使っています。
local: This one uses be going to.
ja_pron: Kore wa be going to o tsukatte imasu.
native: This one uses be going to.

en: The subject is he and so the beaver to use is is.
zh: 主詞是 he，所以用 be 動詞 is。
ja: 主語は he なので、be 動詞は is を使います。
local: The subject is he and so the beaver to use is is.
ja_pron: Shugo wa he nano de, be dōshi wa is o tsukaimasu.
native: The subject is he and so the beaver to use is is.

en: Then we have going to and then the base verb.
zh: 然後我們有 going to，接著是動詞原形。
ja: 次に going to と動詞の原形があります。
local: Then we have going to and then the base verb.
native: Then we have going to and then the base verb.

en: He is going to play with us.
zh: 他將要和我們一起玩。
ja: 彼は私たちと遊ぶつもりです。
local: He is going to play with us.
native: He is going to play with us.

en: When I make a question, I simply again change the order of the first two words.
zh: 當我造問題時，我只要把前兩個字的順序調換。
ja: 質問を作るときは、最初の二語の順序を入れ替えるだけです。
local: When I make a question, I simply again change the order of the first two words.
native: When I make a question, I simply again change the order of the first two words.

en: Is he going to play with us?
zh: 他會和我們一起玩嗎？
ja: 彼は私たちと遊ぶつもりですか？
local: Is he going to play with us?
native: Is he going to play with us?

en: Now if the subject were to be you or we or they, we would say they are.
zh: 現在如果主詞是你、我們或他們，我們會說 they are。
ja: 主語が you、we、they の場合は they are と言います。
local: Now if the subject were to be you or we or they, we would say they are.
native: Now if the subject were to be you or we or they, we would say they are.

en: And so the question would say are they?
zh: 所以問題會是 are they？
ja: 質問は are they? となります。
local: And so the question would say are they?
native: And so the question would say are they?

en: Are they going to play with them?
zh: 他們會和他們一起玩嗎？
ja: 彼らは彼らと遊ぶつもりですか？
local: Are they going to play with them?
native: Are they going to play with them?

en: For example, so again, remember for will in the future simple tense, just say will subject
zh: 例如，再次提醒，未來簡單式用 will 時，只要說 will 加主詞
ja: 例えば、未来形の will は will と主語を言うだけです。
local: For example, so again, remember for will in the future simple tense, just say will subject
native: For example, so again, remember for will in the future simple tense, just say will subject

en: and then the base form of the verb.
zh: 然後接動詞原形。
ja: その後に動詞の原形を続けます。
local: and then the base form of the verb.
native: and then the base form of the verb.

en: However, for be going to questions, make sure that you pay attention to the proper beaver verb to use at the beginning of the question.
zh: 不過，be going to 的疑問句，要注意問題開頭要用正確的 be 動詞。
ja: しかし、be going to の疑問文では、最初に正しい be 動詞を使うことに注意してください。
local: However, for be going to questions, make sure that you pay attention to the proper beaver verb to use at the beginning of the question.
native: However, for be going to questions, make sure that you pay attention to the proper beaver verb to use at the beginning of the question.

en: To answer the first question, will he play with us?
zh: 回答第一個問題，will he play with us？
ja: 最初の質問、will he play with us? に答えます。
local: To answer the first question, will he play with us?
native: To answer the first question, will he play with us?

en: You can say yes, he will or no, he won't.
zh: 你可以說是的，他會，或不，他不會。
ja: はい、彼はそうします、またはいいえ、彼はしませんと言えます。
local: You can say yes, he will or no, he won't.
native: You can say yes, he will or no, he won't.

en: Is he going to play with us?
zh: 他會和我們一起玩嗎？
ja: 彼は私たちと遊ぶつもりですか？
local: Is he going to play with us?
native: Is he going to play with us?

en: You can say yes, he's going to or no, he isn't going to.
zh: 你可以說是的，他會，或不，他不會。
ja: はい、彼はそうします、またはいいえ、彼はしませんと言えます。
local: You can say yes, he's going to or no, he isn't going to.
native: You can say yes, he's going to or no, he isn't going to.

en: Let's move on.
zh: 我們繼續。
ja: 続けましょう。
local: Let's move on.
native: Let's move on.

en: Let's look at how to form WH questions in the future simple tense.
zh: 我們來看看未來簡單式的 WH 疑問句怎麼造。
ja: 未来形の WH 疑問文の作り方を見てみましょう。
local: Let's look at how to form WH questions in the future simple tense.
native: Let's look at how to form WH questions in the future simple tense.

en: If you notice, each question begins with a WH word, who, when, where and what?
zh: 你會發現每個問題都是以 WH 詞開頭，who、when、where 和 what。
ja: 気づいたかもしれませんが、各質問は WH 語の who、when、where、what で始まります。
local: If you notice, each question begins with a WH word, who, when, where and what?
native: If you notice, each question begins with a WH word, who, when, where and what?

en: The first two sentences use will for the future simple tense.
zh: 前兩句用 will 來表示未來簡單式。
ja: 最初の二文は未来形の will を使っています。
local: The first two sentences use will for the future simple tense.
native: The first two sentences use will for the future simple tense.

en: Who will win the game?
zh: 誰會贏得比賽？
ja: 誰が試合に勝ちますか？
local: Who will win the game?
native: Who will win the game?

en: To answer, I can say my team will win the game.
zh: 回答時，我可以說我的隊伍會贏。
ja: 答えるときは、私のチームが勝つと言えます。
local: To answer, I can say my team will win the game.
native: To answer, I can say my team will win the game.

en: When will they arrive?
zh: 他們什麼時候到？
ja: 彼らはいつ到着しますか？
local: When will they arrive?
native: When will they arrive?

en: They will arrive in two hours.
zh: 他們兩小時後會到。
ja: 彼らは2時間後に到着します。
local: They will arrive in two hours.
native: They will arrive in two hours.

en: Now, these two sentences have be going to.
zh: 現在這兩句用的是 be going to。
ja: 次の二文は be going to を使っています。
local: Now, these two sentences have be going to.
native: Now, these two sentences have be going to.

en: Where is he going to study?
zh: 他將在哪裡讀書？
ja: 彼はどこで勉強するつもりですか？
local: Where is he going to study?
native: Where is he going to study?

en: In this case, I have the beaver is because the subject is he.
zh: 這裡用 be 動詞 is，因為主詞是 he。
ja: この場合、主語が he なので be 動詞は is です。
local: In this case, I have the beaver is because the subject is he.
native: In this case, I have the beaver is because the subject is he.

en: Where is he going to study?
zh: 他將在哪裡讀書？
ja: 彼はどこで勉強するつもりですか？
local: Where is he going to study?
native: Where is he going to study?

en: I can say he is going to study at the library.
zh: 我可以說他將在圖書館讀書。
ja: 彼は図書館で勉強するつもりだと言えます。
local: I can say he is going to study at the library.
native: I can say he is going to study at the library.

en: And finally, what are you going to do?
zh: 最後，你打算做什麼？
ja: 最後に、あなたは何をするつもりですか？
local: And finally, what are you going to do?
native: And finally, what are you going to do?

en: In this case, I use the beaver bar because the subject is you.
zh: 這裡用 be 動詞 are，因為主詞是 you。
ja: この場合、主語が you なので be 動詞は are です。
local: In this case, I use the beaver bar because the subject is you.
native: In this case, I use the beaver bar because the subject is you.

en: What are you going to do?
zh: 你打算做什麼？
ja: あなたは何をするつもりですか？
local: What are you going to do?
native: What are you going to do?

en: I am going to take a shower.
zh: 我打算去洗澡。
ja: 私はシャワーを浴びるつもりです。
local: I am going to take a shower.
native: I am going to take a shower.

en: Let's move on.
zh: 我們繼續。
ja: 続けましょう。
local: Let's move on.
native: Let's move on.

en: For this checkup, let's take a look at the will usage for the future simple tense.
zh: 這次複習，我們來看看未來簡單式中 will 的用法。
ja: この確認のために、未来形の will の使い方を見てみましょう。
local: For this checkup, let's take a look at the will usage for the future simple tense.
native: For this checkup, let's take a look at the will usage for the future simple tense.

en: The first example says Jen and Paul blink home soon with the verb go.
zh: 第一個例子是 Jen 和 Paul blink 很快回家，動詞是 go。
ja: 最初の例は Jen と Paul が go を使ってすぐに帰るという文です。
local: The first example says Jen and Paul blink home soon with the verb go.
native: The first example says Jen and Paul blink home soon with the verb go.

en: Remember, when using will for the future simple tense, it doesn't matter what the subject is.
zh: 記住，未來簡單式用 will 時，主詞是什麼都沒關係。
ja: 未来形の will を使うときは、主語が何であっても関係ありません。
local: Remember, when using will for the future simple tense, it doesn't matter what the subject is.
native: Remember, when using will for the future simple tense, it doesn't matter what the subject is.

en: We say will and then the base verb.
zh: 我們說 will，然後接動詞原形。
ja: will と動詞の原形を言います。
local: We say will and then the base verb.
native: We say will and then the base verb.

en: So here, we can say Jen and Paul or they will go home soon.
zh: 所以這裡我們可以說 Jen and Paul 或 they will go home soon。
ja: だからここでは Jen and Paul または they will go home soon と言えます。
local: So here, we can say Jen and Paul or they will go home soon.
native: So here, we can say Jen and Paul or they will go home soon.

en: I blink a scientist after I graduate.
zh: 我 blink 畢業後成為科學家。
ja: 私は卒業後に科学者になります。
local: I blink a scientist after I graduate.
native: I blink a scientist after I graduate.

en: Try filling in the blink with B.
zh: 試著用 B 填入 blink。
ja: blink に B を入れてみましょう。
local: Try filling in the blink with B.
native: Try filling in the blink with B.

en: Again, we simply say will be.
zh: 我們只要說 will be。
ja: もう一度、will be と言います。
local: Again, we simply say will be.
native: Again, we simply say will be.

en: I will be a scientist after I graduate.
zh: 我畢業後會成為科學家。
ja: 私は卒業後に科学者になります。
local: I will be a scientist after I graduate.
native: I will be a scientist after I graduate.

en: Now, try this one.
zh: 現在，試試這句。
ja: では、これをやってみましょう。
local: Now, try this one.
native: Now, try this one.

en: We blink that because it smells bad.
zh: 我們 blink 那個，因為它聞起來很臭。
ja: 私たちはそれを blink します、臭いからです。
local: We blink that because it smells bad.
native: We blink that because it smells bad.

en: I want you to use the negative form with the verb eat.
zh: 我希望你用 eat 的否定形式。
ja: eat の否定形を使ってください。
local: I want you to use the negative form with the verb eat.
native: I want you to use the negative form with the verb eat.

en: Here, we say will not eat or remember we can use the contraction won't.
zh: 這裡我們說 will not eat，或記得可以用縮寫 won't。
ja: ここでは will not eat と言いますが、短縮形の won't も使えます。
local: Here, we say will not eat or remember we can use the contraction won't.
native: Here, we say will not eat or remember we can use the contraction won't.

en: We will not eat that or we won't eat that because it smells bad.
zh: 我們不會吃那個，因為它聞起來很臭。
ja: 私たちはそれを食べません、臭いからです。
local: We will not eat that or we won't eat that because it smells bad.
native: We will not eat that or we won't eat that because it smells bad.

en: Now, look for the mistake in this sentence.
zh: 現在，找出這句話的錯誤。
ja: では、この文の間違いを探してください。
local: Now, look for the mistake in this sentence.
native: Now, look for the mistake in this sentence.

en: I will eat a pizza for lunch.
zh: 我將吃一個披薩當午餐。
ja: 私は昼食にピザを食べます。
local: I will eat a pizza for lunch.
native: I will eat a pizza for lunch.

en: Remember, we need the base form of the verb.
zh: 記住，我們需要動詞原形。
ja: 動詞の原形が必要です。
local: Remember, we need the base form of the verb.
native: Remember, we need the base form of the verb.

en: I will eat a pizza for lunch.
zh: 我將吃一個披薩當午餐。
ja: 私は昼食にピザを食べます。
local: I will eat a pizza for lunch.
native: I will eat a pizza for lunch.

en: And G and I will play a game.
zh: G 和我將玩一場遊戲。
ja: G と私はゲームをします。
local: And G and I will play a game.
native: And G and I will play a game.

en: Again, we need the base form of the verb.
zh: 同樣，我們需要動詞原形。
ja: 再度、動詞の原形が必要です。
local: Again, we need the base form of the verb.
native: Again, we need the base form of the verb.

en: And G and I will play a game.
zh: G 和我將玩一場遊戲。
ja: G と私はゲームをします。
local: And G and I will play a game.
native: And G and I will play a game.

en: And finally, will she be cooked dinner?
zh: 最後，will she be cooked dinner？
ja: 最後に、will she be cooked dinner? という文です。
local: And finally, will she be cooked dinner?
native: And finally, will she be cooked dinner?

en: This is a question.
zh: 這是一個問題句。
ja: これは疑問文です。
local: This is a question.
native: This is a question.

en: However, we need to say will she cook dinner.
zh: 不過，我們應該說 will she cook dinner。
ja: しかし、will she cook dinner と言うべきです。
local: However, we need to say will she cook dinner.
native: However, we need to say will she cook dinner.

en: We do not need a beaver here.
zh: 這裡不需要 be 動詞。
ja: ここでは be 動詞は不要です。
local: We do not need a beaver here.
native: We do not need a beaver here.

en: Let's move on.
zh: 我們繼續。
ja: 続けましょう。
local: Let's move on.
native: Let's move on.

en: Let's practice the B going to usage of the future simple tense.
zh: 我們來練習未來簡單式中 be going to 的用法。
ja: 未来形の be going to の使い方を練習しましょう。
local: Let's practice the B going to usage of the future simple tense.
native: Let's practice the B going to usage of the future simple tense.

en: We blink going to blank soccer.
zh: 我們 blink going to blank soccer。
ja: We blink going to blank soccer。
local: We blink going to blank soccer.
native: We blink going to blank soccer.

en: I want you to use the verb watch.
zh: 我希望你用動詞 watch。
ja: 動詞 watch を使ってください。
local: I want you to use the verb watch.
native: I want you to use the verb watch.

en: Remember for B going to in the future simple tense, we start with the subject.
zh: 記得未來簡單式的 be going to 是先說主詞。
ja: 未来形の be going to は主語から始めます。
local: Remember for B going to in the future simple tense, we start with the subject.
native: Remember for B going to in the future simple tense, we start with the subject.

en: And then the B verb.
zh: 然後接 be 動詞。
ja: その後に be 動詞を続けます。
local: And then the B verb.
native: And then the B verb.

en: The subject here is we, so we need the B verb R.
zh: 這裡主詞是 we，所以用 be 動詞 are。
ja: ここでは主語が we なので be 動詞は are です。
local: The subject here is we, so we need the B verb R.
native: The subject here is we, so we need the B verb R.

en: We are going to watch soccer.
zh: We are going to，然後接動詞原形 watch。
ja: We are going to の後に動詞の原形 watch を続けます。
local: We are going to watch soccer.
native: We are going to watch soccer.

en: We are going to watch soccer.
zh: 我們將看足球。
ja: 私たちはサッカーを見るつもりです。
local: We are going to watch soccer.
native: We are going to watch soccer.

en: I blink going to blank.
zh: 我 blink going to blank。
ja: I blink going to blank。
local: I blink going to blank.
native: I blink going to blank.

en: The verb is talk and I want you to use the negative form.
zh: 動詞是 talk，我希望你用否定形式。
ja: 動詞は talk で、否定形を使ってください。
local: The verb is talk and I want you to use the negative form.
native: The verb is talk and I want you to use the negative form.

en: In this case, the subject is I and so I use the B verb M.
zh: 這裡主詞是 I，所以用 be 動詞 am。
ja: 主語が I なので be 動詞は am です。
local: In this case, the subject is I and so I use the B verb M.
native: In this case, the subject is I and so I use the B verb M.

en: I am not going to talk.
zh: I am，然後接 not。
ja: I am の後に not を続けます。
local: I am not going to talk.
native: I am not going to talk.

en: I am not going to talk.
zh: 我不打算說話。
ja: 私は話すつもりはありません。
local: I am not going to talk.
native: I am not going to talk.

en: Why blink you going to blank?
zh: 為什麼 blink you going to blank？
ja: なぜ blink you going to blank ですか？
local: Why blink you going to blank?
native: Why blink you going to blank?

en: The verb here is go.
zh: 這裡的動詞是 go。
ja: ここでの動詞は go です。
local: The verb here is go.
native: The verb here is go.

en: In a question, especially a WH question, we start with the WH word and then the B verb R is the correct beaver because the subject is you.
zh: 在疑問句，特別是 WH 疑問句中，我們先說 WH 詞，然後用 be 動詞 are，因為主詞是 you。
ja: 疑問文、特に WH 疑問文では、WH 語の後に be 動詞 are を使います。主語が you だからです。
local: In a question, especially a WH question, we start with the WH word and then the B verb R is the correct beaver because the subject is you.
native: In a question, especially a WH question, we start with the WH word and then the B verb R is the correct beaver because the subject is you.

en: Then we have going to and again the base form of the verb.
zh: 接著是 going to，然後是動詞原形。
ja: 次に going to、その後に動詞の原形が続きます。
local: Then we have going to and again the base form of the verb.
native: Then we have going to and again the base form of the verb.

en: Why are you going to go?
zh: 你為什麼要去？
ja: なぜあなたは行くつもりですか？
local: Why are you going to go?
native: Why are you going to go?

en: Now try to find the mistake in the next sentence.
zh: 現在試著找出下一句的錯誤。
ja: 次の文の間違いを探してみてください。
local: Now try to find the mistake in the next sentence.
native: Now try to find the mistake in the next sentence.

en: You are going to study at home.
zh: 你將會在家學習。
ja: あなたは家で勉強する予定です。
local: You are going to study at home.
native: You are going to study at home.

en: Can you find the mistake?
zh: 你能找到錯誤嗎？
ja: 間違いを見つけられますか？
local: Can you find the mistake?
native: Can you find the mistake?

en: You are going to, that's correct, but we need the base form of the verb.
zh: 你說「You are going to」是正確的，但我們需要動詞的原形。
ja: 「You are going to」は正しいですが、動詞の原形が必要です。
local: You are going to, that's correct, but we need the base form of the verb.
native: You are going to, that's correct, but we need the base form of the verb.

en: You are going to study at home.
zh: 你將會在家學習。
ja: あなたは家で勉強する予定です。
local: You are going to study at home.
native: You are going to study at home.

en: You will be going to learn English.
zh: 你將會去學英語。
ja: あなたは英語を学びに行くでしょう。
local: You will be going to learn English.
native: You will be going to learn English.

en: You will be going, hmm, that sounds a little strange.
zh: 你會去，嗯，聽起來有點奇怪。
ja: 「You will be going」は、うーん、少し変に聞こえます。
local: You will be going, hmm, that sounds a little strange.
native: You will be going, hmm, that sounds a little strange.

en: Remember, we don't need the will here, we're using B going to and we need to change
zh: 記住，這裡不需要 will，我們用的是 be going to，並且需要改變
ja: 覚えておいてください、ここでは will は必要ありません。be going to を使い、
local: Remember, we don't need the will here, we're using B going to and we need to change
native: Remember, we don't need the will here, we're using B going to and we need to change

en: the B to match the subject.
zh: be 動詞以配合主詞。
ja: 主語に合わせて be 動詞を変える必要があります。
local: the B to match the subject.
native: the B to match the subject.

en: You are going to learn English or remember you can also say you will learn English.
zh: 你將會學英語，或者記得你也可以說 you will learn English。
ja: あなたは英語を学ぶ予定です。また、you will learn English とも言えます。
local: You are going to learn English or remember you can also say you will learn English.
native: You are going to learn English or remember you can also say you will learn English.

en: And finally, is he going to do play soccer?
zh: 最後，他會去踢足球嗎？
ja: 最後に、彼はサッカーをする予定ですか？
local: And finally, is he going to do play soccer?
native: And finally, is he going to do play soccer?

en: Uh oh, we have two verbs here.
zh: 糟了，這裡有兩個動詞。
ja: あらら、ここに動詞が二つあります。
local: Uh oh, we have two verbs here.
native: Uh oh, we have two verbs here.

en: Is he going to?
zh: 他會去嗎？
ja: 彼は行くのですか？
local: Is he going to?
native: Is he going to?

en: That's correct, but we have do and play.
zh: 這是正確的，但我們有 do 和 play。
ja: それは正しいですが、do と play があります。
local: That's correct, but we have do and play.
native: That's correct, but we have do and play.

en: We don't need both.
zh: 我們不需要兩個都用。
ja: 両方は必要ありません。
local: We don't need both.
native: We don't need both.

en: So we say, is he going to play soccer?
zh: 所以我們說，他會去踢足球嗎？
ja: だから、is he going to play soccer? と言います。
local: So we say, is he going to play soccer?
native: So we say, is he going to play soccer?

en: Great job everybody, let's move on.
zh: 大家做得很好，我們繼續。
ja: みなさん、よくできました。続けましょう。
local: Great job everybody, let's move on.
native: Great job everybody, let's move on.

en: Great job everyone, you now have a better understanding of the future simple tense.
zh: 大家做得很好，你們現在對未來簡單式有更好的理解了。
ja: みなさん、よくできました。未来形の理解が深まりましたね。
local: Great job everyone, you now have a better understanding of the future simple tense.
native: Great job everyone, you now have a better understanding of the future simple tense.

en: There's still a lot of practice you need to do because this tense is so important.
zh: 你還需要很多練習，因為這個時態非常重要。
ja: この時制はとても重要なので、まだたくさん練習が必要です。
local: There's still a lot of practice you need to do because this tense is so important.
native: There's still a lot of practice you need to do because this tense is so important.

en: Keep studying and I'll see you in the next video.
zh: 繼續學習，我們下個影片見。
ja: 勉強を続けて、次のビデオでお会いしましょう。
local: Keep studying and I'll see you in the next video.
native: Keep studying and I'll see you in the next video.
